Lemma
[Stability of intrinsic hypersurface curvature] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0296 ↗ lem:chow-iv-hypersurface-geometry-ambient-metric-stability 1. ch34:34.20\group Hyperbolic Almost Isometries

With the hypotheses above, if $g_N$ and $\widetilde g_N$ are the two induced metrics, then \[ |\Rm _{g_N}-\Rm _{\widetilde g_N}| \le C\| \widetilde g-g\| _{C^2(M,g)}. \]
Proof

\sketch Use the Gauss formula $ abla ^N_XY= abla _XY+\mathrm{II}(X,Y) u $ for both metrics. Expanding the two intrinsic curvature tensors in terms of these connections and applying Lemma 4 gives the estimate.

□
